decision_conditions: The proposed crossover, by reason of the loss of a substantial section of the grass verge and the removal of a healthy highway tree, would result in harm to the established landscaped character of Kingston Lane. The grass verge and street tree contribute positively to the appearance of the area, and their removal, together with the lack of appropriate, policy compliant replacement planting, would erode the visual amenity of the streetscene. The proposal therefore conflicts with Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Policy BE1 of the Local Plan: Part 1 (2012), and Policies DMHB 11, DMHD 1 and DMHB 14 of the Local Plan: Part 2 (2020)

The proposed crossover, would introduce unsafe turning movements on a classified road and bus route. It would increase conflict between vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists and fails to comply with the Council's Domestic Vehicle Footway Crossover Policy (June 2022), particularly in respect of roundabout proximity, excessive verge width and the impact on a healthy highway tree. As such, the proposal would result in an unacceptable impact on highway safety, contrary to Paragraph 116 of the NPPF (2024), Policy T4 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies DMT 1 and DMT 2 of the Local Plan: Part 2 (2020).
description: Installation of a vehicle crossover including alterations to existing wall and removal and replacement of street tree.
